name: Couch Stretch
cues: Back knee on floor near couch/wall with rear foot elevated. Drive hips forward, squeeze rear glute. Keep torso tall — don't lean back.

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
cues: Sit with both legs bent at 90°. Front shin faces forward, rear shin faces back. Tall spine. Hinge forward over front shin to increase stretch.

name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch
cues: Lie on your back. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee (like a figure-4). Pull both legs toward chest until you feel a deep glute stretch.

name: Seated Figure-4
cues: Sit upright on a chair. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee. Sit tall and hinge slightly forward from hips.

name: Pigeon Pose
cues: From all-fours, bring one shin across the mat, rear leg extended behind you. Square hips forward. Fold forward to deepen. Breathe slow — don't rush this one.

name: Frog Stretch
cues: On hands and knees, spread knees wide until you feel the inner-thigh pull. Rock gently forward and back. Let your hips sink toward the floor.

name: Lateral Lunge
cues: Step wide to one side, bend that knee, keep the opposite leg completely straight. Chest up, weight through the heel of the bent leg.

name: Deep Squat Hold
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes out. Drop into full squat, heels flat on floor. Elbows press knees out. Grab a post or doorframe for balance if needed.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Start in a deep lunge. Plant same-side hand beside foot, rotate top arm toward the ceiling — hold. Then straighten front knee and hold the hamstring stretch.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Half-kneeling position, back knee on the floor. Drive hips forward while keeping torso tall. Tuck pelvis slightly to increase the stretch.

name: Sumo Squat Hold
cues: Wide stance with toes out ~45°. Drop into a squat and hold. Elbows press knees open. Great beginner alternative to frog stretch.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
cues: Stand on one leg, pull the opposite heel toward your glute. Keep knees together, stand tall. Use a wall for balance.

name: Cat-Cow
cues: On hands and knees, neutral spine. Inhale: drop belly, lift head (Cow). Exhale: round spine up, tuck chin (Cat). Move slow and controlled through full range.

name: Child's Pose
cues: Kneel and sit back toward heels, arms reach forward. Breathe INTO your lower back — feel it rise and fall. Walk hands further to deepen the shoulder stretch.

name: Supine Knee-to-Chest
cues: Lying on your back. Pull one knee toward chest, keep the opposite leg relaxed on the floor. Feel the lower back decompress.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
cues: Lying on back, bend one knee and pull it across your body. Keep the opposite shoulder flat on the floor. Let gravity do the twisting — don't force it.

name: Press-Up / Cobra
cues: Lie face down, hands under shoulders. Press up slowly, let hips stay on the ground. Elbows slightly soft. Great for disc decompression — stop if you feel nerve symptoms.

name: Thread the Needle
cues: On all fours. Slide one arm under your body until that shoulder touches the floor. Rest your head down and breathe into the rotation.

name: Quadruped Rock-Back
cues: On all fours, neutral spine. Rock your hips BACK toward your heels — stop just before your lower back rounds. Return to start. Move slow and deliberate.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
cues: Stand, place one heel forward on a step or floor. Hinge at the hips — keep a FLAT back, don't round. Feel the pull behind your knee.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
cues: Lying on your back. Lift one leg, hold behind the thigh (use a towel or strap for tight hamstrings). Straighten the knee until you feel the pull. Flex your foot.

name: Seated Forward Fold
cues: Sit with both legs extended. Hinge forward from the HIPS — flat back as long as possible. Use a towel looped around your feet if very tight. Don't pull with your arms.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
cues: Sit on the edge of a chair. Extend one leg out straight with a flexed foot. Hinge slightly forward from the hips. Easy entry-level hamstring stretch.

name: Half-Kneel Ankle Dorsiflexion
cues: Half-kneeling. Drive your front knee forward over your toes without the heel lifting. Shift weight forward. Move the knee left and right to hit all angles.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
cues: Hands on wall. Step one foot back, heel flat on floor, leg straight. Lean forward until the calf engages. Do NOT let the heel come up.

name: Bent-Knee Calf Stretch
cues: Same setup as wall calf stretch, but bend the rear knee slightly. This targets the Soleus — the deeper calf muscle often missed by straight-leg stretches.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
cues: Pull one arm horizontally across your chest with the opposite arm. Keep your shoulder DOWN — don't shrug. Feel the pull in the back of the shoulder.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
cues: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame (elbows at 90°). Step one foot forward to increase intensity. Do NOT arch your lower back.

name: Wall Pec Stretch
cues: Place one arm flat against a wall at shoulder height. Rotate your body away until the chest stretches. Start with arm at 90° and adjust angle for comfort.

name: Sleeper Stretch
cues: Lie on your side with the bottom arm at 90°. Use your top hand to gently push the bottom forearm toward the floor. Stop well short of pain — this targets the posterior capsule.

name: Overhead Lat Stretch
cues: Stand beside a wall, reach up and place hand on it. Lean your body away and slightly forward. Feel the stretch down the side of your torso.

name: Happy Baby Pose
cues: Lying on your back. Grab the outsides of your feet and pull your knees toward your armpits. Rock gently side-to-side. This is pure decompression — enjoy it.

name: Legs Up The Wall
cues: Scoot your hips close to a wall and swing legs vertically up it. Arms relax at your sides. Close your eyes and breathe slow. This is active recovery — let gravity do the work.
